'**Instant** - Discard this, BANISH X CARDS FROM YOUR SOUL: Turn X target cards in a banished zone FACE-DOWN.'

The X was absent entirely. The cost was DISCARD_SELF alone, so the ability was free, and the effect was a FLIP_REF on ref 'banished' -- a reference nothing in the ability ever set, since there was no banish to set it. Both halves of X were therefore missing: nothing was paid, and nothing was chosen to flip.

It also flipped the WRONG WAY. FLIP_REF defaults face_up to true, and the card says face-DOWN. Turning cards in a banished zone face UP is close to the opposite effect: face-down banished cards are hidden information, and revealing them helps the opponent as readily as it helps you.

BANISH_FROM_SOUL is new. The soul is NOT the graveyard (CR 3.11.5: the collection of sub-objects under the hero card), and it is the scarce resource this cost is priced against. X is chosen by the player when paying, and stamped on the card as x_paid so the effect's target count can read it -- play.py stamps X only for a card's PLAY cost, never for an activated ability's.

The unread 'to_zone': 'banished' is gone: FLIP_REF does not move cards, and the cards named are already in a banished zone.

Also removed a GO_AGAIN effect on the PLAY ability. Go again is PRINTED here (has_go_again is already true from the card DB and conditional_keywords strips nothing), so the JSON was granting a second copy of a keyword CR 8.3.5b says an object cannot have twice.
